note: Public history of every ARXOS kernel. Text only: the patch code and config stay private. Binaries live on Cloudflare R2 (current, fast) and archive.org / GitHub Releases (full history, rollback).

linux-arxos-stable.role: default on the stable series, fewer changes

tunes.name: Live kernel patching
tunes.advantage: Security and stability fixes can be applied to the running kernel without a reboot, so the machine stays up to date without downtime.

tunes.name: Kernel-level anonymity primitives
tunes.advantage: The building blocks the ARXOS privacy tools rely on are compiled in: modern packet filtering, WireGuard, network and user isolation, and encrypted key storage. AnonKit and friends work at the kernel level, not bolted on top.

tunes.name: Low-level device access
tunes.advantage: Fast, direct device input and output is enabled for the ARXOS device toolkit, including raw USB access and a high-performance I/O path. This is what lets droidB talk to hardware quickly and reliably.

tunes.name: Performance base
tunes.advantage: ARXOS keeps a tuned performance profile: a responsive desktop scheduler, faster network throughput, a high timer rate, full preemption for low latency, a modern CPU baseline, and better memory behaviour under load. The result is a system that feels quick and stays quick.

kernels.changes: Real-time (PREEMPT_RT + rt-bore) on the newest mainline, Linux 7.3.0, with the full ARXOS hardening and privacy set carried forward: forced-threaded IRQs, 1000 Hz, lockdown, IMA, strict IOMMU, memory zeroing on allocation and free, live patching, and the kernel-level network privacy additions. No LTO (RT and LTO do not mix). Supersedes the 7.2.5 real-time build.

New flavor: the newest release of the stable 7.2 series, Linux 7.2.13, with the same tuning as linux-arxos (BORE scheduler, ThinLTO, 1000 Hz, x86-64-v3), the full ARXOS hardening set and the kernel-level network privacy additions. Choose it when you value fewer changes over the newest features.

Moves the default kernel to the newest mainline, Linux 7.3.0. Keeps the BORE scheduler, ThinLTO, 1000 Hz and the x86-64-v3 baseline with the full ARXOS hardening set (lockdown, IMA, strict IOMMU, memory zeroing on allocation and free, live patching), and adds kernel-level network privacy: link-layer MAC rewrite and filtering, NAT and redirect for the transparent proxy, packet logging for AnonKit, SYN cookies, reverse-path filtering and IPv6 privacy support.

Real-time (PREEMPT_RT + BORE) rebased onto Linux 7.2.5 with the full ARXOS hardening set: latest upstream security fixes, forced-threaded IRQs, RCU boost, 1000 Hz, plus lockdown, IMA, IOMMU-strict, init-on-alloc/free and live patching. No LTO (RT and LTO do not mix).

Rebased onto Linux 7.2.5 with the full ARXOS performance and hardening set carried forward: latest upstream security fixes, tuned scheduler, full preemption, 1000 Hz, ThinLTO, plus lockdown, IMA, IOMMU-strict, init-on-alloc/free and live patching.

Real-time build (PREEMPT_RT) with the same 7.2.0-2 delta as the default flavor: DEATHSTROKE and hardening (memory wiped on free and alloc, hibernation disabled, IMA measured boot, IOMMU strict, kernel lockdown in integrity mode from early boot, restricted dmesg) plus live kernel patching. Bounded, predictable latency for RF, SDR, and wireless capture.

Adds the DEATHSTROKE and hardening delta: memory wiped on free and on alloc, hibernation disabled so no plaintext key lands in swap, IMA measured boot, IOMMU enforced in strict mode, kernel lockdown in integrity mode from early boot, restricted dmesg, and live kernel patching. Rebased on the latest 7.2.0 base with the full ArxOS tune set.

Real-time flavor: PREEMPT_RT + BORE. Same ArxOS tuning and the same offensive/defensive tool support as linux-arxos, but with hard real-time preemption (bounded worst-case latency, threaded IRQs) for RF, SDR, and wireless capture where timing must be exact. Trades a little raw throughput for predictable latency; linux-arxos stays the default daily driver.
Rebased onto the newer upstream (Linux 7.2.0). Carries the full ARXOS tune set unchanged: live patching, kernel-level anonymity primitives, low-level device access, and the tuned performance base.
First kernel of this ARXOS line. Established the ARXOS tune set over the tuned base. Superseded by 7.2.0-1.
